# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Paladin level 10 progression fixture — the
# level-10 band closer: with this fixture's slice every one of the ten
# level-banded class rows is grounded through level 10, the tranche ceiling.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Paladin
# level-1..level-9 hybrid chassis baseline to level 10 as chosen input only.
# It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat), the deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield /
# Power Attack posture, and the level-3..level-9 fixture's
# choice=choice:paladin_mercy selection (mercy:shaken) unchanged -- the PF1
# CRB level-10 "Special" column reads "Smite evil 4/day" only (verified
# independently against both d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com): the uses/day
# rise is already captured by the grounded Smite Evil uses-per-day formula
# (1 + (level - 1) / 3), so this fixture adds no new selection for it; 10th
# is NOT a repeat-Mercy-grant level (the 3rd/6th/9th cadence), so the single
# grounded level-3 selection carries over unchanged.
#
# Aura of Resolve (8th) remains named-but-unproven exactly as the level-8
# slice left it (condition-immunity + ally-aura engines, neither of which
# exists in this codebase); this fixture makes no aura claim either way.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later hybrid burden surface: no spell
# selections, no spells known/prepared posture, no domains, no mercy EFFECT
# resolution, no channel positive energy healing/damage-resolution execution,
# no Divine Bond (weapon bond / mount bond) selection or execution, and no
# alignment-target or healing-resource accounting, and no level-11+
# progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-paladin-level10
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:paladin:10
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:diplomacy:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
choice=choice:paladin_mercy:mercy:shaken
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
